newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures closed mixed on Thursday, as bullish sentiment from the morning evaporated, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.4 yen down to 0.6 yen up, and the benchmark June 1997 month was down 0.1 yen at 147.0 yen per kg.
All months were higher at the opening due to technical buying from local investors, traders said. But the bullish sentiment failed to remain throughout the day, they said.
"Local investors are shifting their money to grain contracts, such as corn, looking for more volatile markets," a brokerage house trader said.
